findings.title: Authorize every represented Matter before receipt hash comparison/replay
findings.trigger: Create receipt in A; revoke actor membership in A; keep actor authorized in B; submit same actor+key in B with a different trusted hash.
findings.observed: ErrIdempotencyKeyReuse instead of uniform ErrNotFound; receipt existence is distinguished before checking saved scope/represented-Matter authority.
findings.cause: Only target B accessFrom is checked; rcpt.ScopeKind/WorkspaceID/MatterID/Matters are never authorized before comparing hash or reading Snapshot.
findings.impact: Violates required replay current authorization and uniform denial; matching inconsistent trusted fingerprints could also return an unauthorized stored body, but no production hash-collision claim is made.
findings.smallest_fix: Authorize saved scope and every represented Matter within the locked transaction before age/hash/output; preserve deterministic lock order; no domain effect or body leak on denial.

findings.title: Fail closed on unsupported pending temporal boundary
findings.trigger: Matter header has next_boundary_at earlier than t_cmd; call CreateRequirement.
findings.observed: Create returns success, CompleteMatter runs, one Requirement is persisted in test double.
findings.cause: Service ignores NextBoundaryAt and BoundariesAppliedUntil; SQL CompleteMatter advances fence and clears next_boundary_at=NULL unconditionally.
findings.impact: Can silently erase an unevaluated boundary in a populated Matter; contradicts explicit BE01 fail-closed rule even though this slice creates no due dates.
findings.smallest_fix: Refuse required unsupported boundary before new mutation/fence clearing; leave rows/history/receipt/fence unchanged; do not implement the later full temporal engine.

findings.title: Propagate membership storage failures before converting access facts
findings.trigger: Requirement read exists, WorkspaceMembership returns ErrUnavailable.
findings.cause: accessFrom treats every non-nil membership error as absent facts, without first propagating non-ErrNotFound errors.
findings.impact: Dependency failure becomes false not-found and may purge valid UI context; create path has same normalization seam, though PostgreSQL transaction-abort behavior may surface a later commit error.
findings.smallest_fix: Only absent rows become missing facts; propagate unavailable/unexpected errors on read/create/replay and preserve wrapped causes.
